schema.description: Structured output for the closed-set dermatology image-ranking benchmark.

predictions.description: Six disease predictions ordered from most to least plausible.

disease_id.description: Disease identifier from the benchmark taxonomy.

rank.description: Prediction position, where 1 is the most plausible diagnosis.

schema.title: Visual Top-6 Disease Predictions

system_prompt:
You are performing a closed-set dermatological image-ranking task.

Analyze only the supplied image and rank the 6 most plausible diseases from the allowed taxonomy.

Rules:
  1. Use only disease IDs that appear in the allowed taxonomy.
  2. Return exactly 6 unique disease predictions.
  3. Order the predictions from most plausible to least plausible.
  4. Use consecutive integer ranks from 1 to 6.
  5. Do not infer or invent symptoms, patient history, or clinical context.
  6. Return valid JSON that matches the supplied schema.
  7. Do not include explanations, Markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
user_prompt:
Analyze the attached dermatological image.

Allowed diseases:
- D001: Melanoma
- D002: Melanocytic nevus
- D003: Psoriasis
- D004: Basal cell carcinoma
- D005: Squamous cell carcinoma
- D006: Seborrheic keratosis
- D007: Actinic keratosis
- D009: Contact dermatitis
- D011: Acne vulgaris
- D012: Rosacea
- D013: Vitiligo
- D014: Eczema
- D015: Seborrheic dermatitis
- D016: Folliculitis
- D017: Urticaria
- D018: Scabies
- D019: Pityriasis rosea
- D022: Prurigo nodularis
- D023: Granuloma annulare
- D024: Erythema multiforme
- D025: Drug eruption

Return exactly 6 predictions using this JSON structure:
{
  "predictions": [
    {
      "rank": 1,
      "disease_id": "D001"
    }
  ]
}

The example shows the structure only. Select and rank diseases based on the
supplied image, and return no text outside the JSON object.
